plan.summary:
Export `RetryPolicy` from the public entry points of both the TypeScript package and the Rust crate, so library users can build their own retry policy.

- `src/index.ts` re-exports `RetryPolicy` and the `RetryOptions` type from `./retry`.
- `crates/core/src/lib.rs` re-exports `retry::RetryPolicy` at the crate root.
plan.riskRationale: Two one-line re-exports of existing items. No logic changes. The public API surface grows, so the names become part of the contract.
plan.storyArc: One goal: let library users reach the retry policy. The change adds the public re-export in each language package. One topic covers both, because they are the same API change.

topics.title: Expose RetryPolicy in the public API of both packages
topics.narrativeBrief: What new names can library users import from each package root? Verify that `./retry` and `retry` already define these items. Note that the TypeScript side also exports `RetryOptions` and the Rust side does not export a matching options type.
